6Read the posts. Write D (Dila), E (Eren) or Y (Yasemin).

Dila: I usually help in the garden on Thursdays. This week, we are planting flowers every day for the school exhibition. I am learning the names of new plants.

Eren: I play basketball twice a week. At the moment, my team is preparing for an interschool match. Our coach is teaching us a new move.

Yasemin: I am a school volunteer. We meet the headteacher every month. Right now, we are collecting large-print books for students who find small print difficult to read.

    A coach is helping me now.

  5. 5

    I meet the headteacher once a month.

  6. 6

    I am learning plant names.

7Read about the open day. Mark T or F and correct the false sentences.

Our school holds an open day in June. This year it is on a Sunday. The students in 6-C are preparing an exhibition of recycled objects. They are making pencil holders from old tins right now. The robotics club usually meets on Mondays, but this week the members are working on their robot car every afternoon. Parents bring fruit and sandwiches for a small café in the school garden. The students sell the food to buy sports equipment for a village school. A new lift beside the stairs helps wheelchair users reach the upstairs exhibition. Mr Yaman, our headteacher, checks every classroom. “Everyone can take part,” he says.

9Match the questions and Mert’s replies. There is one extra reply.

Questions

  1. 1

    Which national day do you enjoy most?

  2. 2

    What do people do on that day?

  3. 3

    What activities do you have at school?

  4. 4

    Which religious festival do you celebrate?

  5. 5

    How do you feel during celebrations?

Replies

  • a) We put on a play and display our art.
  • b) We celebrate Eid al-Adha and visit our family.
  • c) I enjoy 23 April, Children’s Day.
  • d) I feel cheerful and thankful.
  • e) Our maths lesson finishes at twelve.
  • f) They watch children’s performances and hang flags.

Extra: e

10Read Mert’s email. Answer the questions and number the parts.

(1) Hi Alex, I want to tell you about two celebrations in Türkiye.

(2) I love 23 April, National Sovereignty and Children’s Day. People hang flags and watch children’s performances. At school, we put on a play and display our paintings.

(3) At Eid al-Adha, we visit older relatives and share food with our neighbours. My cousins come to our home.

(4) Today I am making a paper crown for our Children’s Day play. Celebrations make me feel cheerful and thankful.

(5) Which celebration do you like best? Please write back. Mert

  1. 1

    What do people watch on 23 April?

  2. 2

    What do students display at school?

  3. 3

    Who visits Mert at Eid al-Adha?

  4. 4

    What is Mert making today?

Number the parts

religious festival: national day: introduction: current activity and feelings: ending:
